C.A.S.S.I.E: SCP-173 terminated by automatic security system.
ISB Controller: SCP-173 contained successfully by Foxtrot Unit 1.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Warning. Warning. This is not a drill. Repeat. This is not a drill. This is an emergency
SCP Foundation Announcement: broadcast. If you are receiving this broadcast, you may be in immediate danger. This is a
SCP Foundation Announcement: warning message from the SCP Foundation. SCP 173, also known as the sculpture, has escaped
SCP Foundation Announcement: its holding cell and is roaming free.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Last seen within the facility,
SCP Foundation Announcement: there have been unconfirmed sightings
SCP Foundation Announcement: of it outside in the local area.
SCP Foundation Announcement: SCP-173 can be described as a humanoid statue
SCP Foundation Announcement: composed of rebar, concrete and Krylon spray paint,
SCP Foundation Announcement: measuring 2.0 meters tall and weighing approximately 468 kilograms.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Resembles a nightmare has short arms and legs.
SCP Foundation Announcement: It is believed that they kill for enjoyment only.
SCP Foundation Announcement: they do not seem to need to eat or consume in any way.
SCP Foundation Announcement: They do not eat to live but kill for pleasure.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Repeat, they do not eat to live but kill for pleasure. Exact origins are unknown.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Though it is theorized that SCP-173 came from another universe to our world,
SCP Foundation Announcement: after its own was destroyed by another SCP.
SCP Foundation Announcement: It is theorized that it was created by an artist of some kind, perhaps another anomaly.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Though at this point, this is all speculation,
SCP Foundation Announcement: as the original files reporting on SCP-173 were lost.
SCP Foundation Announcement: This SCP is incredibly hostile, and will kill without hesitation.
SCP Foundation Announcement: If you see SCP-173, you must maintain direct eye contact.
SCP Foundation Announcement: This is its only weakness.
SCP Foundation Announcement: It cannot move if it is within a person's line of sight.
SCP Foundation Announcement: However, SCP-173 is able to kill its victims if the person so much as blinks.
SCP Foundation Announcement: No matter how difficult it might be, you must never blink.
SCP Foundation Announcement: You must never blink while in the presence of SCP-173 as it can kill you within a single second.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Repeat, you must never blink while in the presence of SCP-173 as it can kill you within a single second.
SCP Foundation Announcement: If you notice SCP-173 in your presence, you are in immediate and life-threatening danger.
SCP Foundation Announcement: To protect yourself in this scenario, we advise you to back away slowly.
SCP Foundation Announcement: It is theorized that while SCP-173 can move at great speeds,
SCP Foundation Announcement: it can only move certain distances, so try to get as much distance as you can between yourself and it.
SCP Foundation Announcement: The best way to escape this SCP is to back away, maintain eye contact,
SCP Foundation Announcement: do not blink, and gain as much distance as you can before backing around a corner or an object.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Do not blink, maintain eye contact as you hide behind cover.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Once you are free from its line of sight, you can escape.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Run and call for help.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Alert the relevant authorities and evacuate the area.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Inform everyone you can of the situation and flee with them.
SCP Foundation Announcement: It is advised to stay in groups wherever possible.
SCP Foundation Announcement: The larger the better, that way.
SCP Foundation Announcement: If SCP-173 does appear again, it is safer and easier
SCP Foundation Announcement: to maintain eye contact for prolonged periods of time.
SCP Foundation Announcement: In this scenario, SCP-173 can be contained to a specific area and captured more easily by the Foundation.
SCP Foundation Announcement: SCP-173 has been reported to only attack humans.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Studies have been conducted with chimps and other primates, but no animal casualties have been reported.
SCP Foundation Announcement: It is unpredictable and considered to be somewhat intelligent.
SCP Foundation Announcement: It seems unable to communicate outside a few words of broken English, though seems to resent and even hate its captors.
SCP Foundation Announcement: It is never seen moving its body, but seems to teleport to different locations in order to kill.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Extremely hostile, it can snap a human neck so hard it's like being decapitated,
SCP Foundation Announcement: with the end result being the head facing the opposite direction.
SCP Foundation Announcement: It kills by snapping the neck of victim at the base of the skull, or occasionally by strangulation.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Behavior cannot be accurately predicted either because SCP-173 behaves outside of current scientific knowledge, and its nature is simply too poorly understood at present.
SCP Foundation Announcement: SCP-173 is on the loose and must be contained.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Remember the advice given in this broadcast.
SCP Foundation Announcement: This broadcast will now repeat one more time before ending. Thank you for listening.
SCP Foundation Announcement: Stay tuned for further updates.
